verdict.rationale: Supabase clearly documents Read Replicas as a feature for load balancing, latency, and redundancy (supabase-docs-21/39), and documents daily backups (supabase-docs-11), but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of automated failover behavior (e.g., promoting a replica to primary) or SLA/uptime guarantees, and community evidence shows a real operational reliability gap where nightly pg_dump backups took the database fully offline due to write contention (supabase-comm-4), undercutting confidence in documented HA robustness. Missing for 10: explicit failover/promotion mechanics documentation, HA SLA details, and independent verification that failover works as described.
